metadata.description: Empirical network topology metrics for the MASSIVE calibration pipeline.  Computed from a representative social network graph (N=5000) whose parameters are calibrated to real social-media studies.
references: Bakshy et al. (2015) — Echo chambers on Facebook
Conover et al. (2011) — Social media community structure

degree_distribution.notes: Barabási & Albert predict γ = 3 in the idealised model, but empirical social networks exhibit γ ≈ 2.1–2.3. We use γ = 2.15 as a conservative midpoint.

sources: Del Vicario et al. (2016) — echo chamber formation
Cha et al. (2010) — Twitter influence asymmetry
Marlow et al. (2017) — online engagement metrics
